name: Open Sector - Borg Drone
description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.
